rows.claim: locked atoms force T^{1,1} among all 5-manifolds
rows.why: controlled_uniqueness.json sets global_landscape_uniqueness false. Uniqueness among all 5-manifolds is not claimed.

rows.claim: locked atoms force T^{1,1} only inside first-slice G_SE
rows.why: The file says lambda-tilde, equivalently sigma*=sqrt(3)/2, isolates T^{1,1} among labeled bases in the first slice. The scope is that slice.
Locked b2=1, b3=1. S^5 has b2=0. Q^{1,1,1} as the (1,1,1) circle bundle has b2=2.

rows.claim: Iso=SU(2)×SU(2)×U(1) kills M^{p,q} as this wall
rows.why: This wall's isometry has dimension 7 and no SU(3) factor. M^{p,q} is dimension 7 with an SU(3) factor. Not this wall. (p,q) is not selected.

rows.claim: the wall-index sieve exists only on this Iso
rows.why: The sieve is written in the j1, j2 labels of this isometry. The files do not prove that no other group could carry a three-zero count.

rows.claim: some other locked 5-fold also has exactly three zeros under the same rule with extras=0
rows.why: No second locked 5-fold with that zero count and empty extras is on disk.
